name: io.github.mariohahn/locli
title: locli
description: Find, add, push and pull an app's user-facing texts in locli (iOS, Android, web, backend).

environmentVariables.name: LOCLI_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: locli API token (CI). Locally, run `npx @locli/cli login` instead.

environmentVariables.name: LOCLI_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to locli.json (default: nearest locli.json from the working directory).
